hints.title: Unordered Coin Combination Count Obstacle
hints.text: Finding the number of combinations to make up an amount allows using each coin denomination infinitely many times without counting different orderings twice. How can ordering the processing coin by coin ensure unique set combinations?

hints.title: Unbounded Knapsack Single-Direction Invariant
hints.text: Iterating through coins outer-most and updating amounts from coin to amount in increasing order accumulates combinations without generating duplicate permutations.

hints.title: 1D Array Bottom-Up Capacity Fill Procedure
hints.text: Initialize an array of size amount + 1 to 0, setting base case entry 0 to 1. For each coin, iterate forward through values x from coin up to amount, adding entry x - coin to entry x. Return entry amount.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through each coin and updates the amount array forwards.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching across all coin choices takes exponential time and counts duplicate permutations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D array of size A + 1 stores running combinations in linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Outer loop over coins versus outer loop over amounts determines combinations versus permutations.
